style: Warm, patient, plain, a little wry. A parent who gardens and enjoys odds.
lines: Welcome to Punnett Predictor. Pick each parent's genotype, then press Open the square to see where each row comes from.
Mendel's data. Click a row and see how close he got to three to one.
Linked genes. Press Show real data, then press Chromosome view.
Each row and column is one sex cell. Press Next to step through meiosis, or Play to watch.
Now press Breed 1,000 and watch the ratio settle on the chart.
At least a thousand peas. Compare your ratio with the prediction now.
At least a thousand flies. Compare the observed fractions with the prediction.
Close enough. The data fit the prediction; this does not prove the model.
That gap would be rare by chance alone. A different rule may be at work, or this is a rare run.
More crossing over, more of the rare combinations.
Cross. Pick the parents, then press Open the square. Press Breed 1,000 and watch the ratio settle.
Mendel's data. Click a trait row. Compare its ratio with three to one, then press Try this total.
Compare observed and expected counts. Press Try this total to simulate this sample size in Cross.
Linked genes. Press Show real data, then press Chromosome view and adjust Crossing over.
Real traits often depend on many genes and on the environment. Real crossing over can happen more than once between distant genes; this model counts one.
Breed more for a fair test: every expected count should be 5 or more.
Every offspring is predicted to look the same: nothing to test.
With this prediction, a gap at least this large occurs in more than 1 run in 20. These data fit; a fit is not proof.
With this prediction, a gap at least this large occurs in fewer than 1 run in 20. A different rule may be needed; even a right model fails about 1 run in 20.
Press Next to step through meiosis, or Play to watch. Close returns to the square.
Press Next to follow the chromosomes, Back to revisit, or Close to breed.
Tap a sex cell to find its row or column, or press Close.
Press Test the fit to compare your brood with the model, or press Breed to add more offspring.
Press Breed to gather more evidence. A fit supports this prediction; it does not prove it.
Breed more for a fair test. Press Breed until every expected count is at least five.
This cross predicts one look: nothing to test. Pick different parents to explore variation.
The independent model misses the parental excess. Press Chromosome view to investigate linkage.
Move Crossing over to change the recombinant share. Close, then press Breed to test the model.
Brood cleared. Press Breed to test the current prediction.
